name: CompatibleUnitWorkEstimator
tagline: Price every utility design job from compatible units – and get it approved – in one Power Platform app.
description: Full design-estimating desk for electric distribution: work packages built from a compatible-unit library with install / remove / transfer / abandon costing, stores loading, labour and equipment rates, overhead and contingency, capital vs O&M vs cost of removal, budget variance, approval limits and a status workflow to release – for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Demo mode with 14 fictional work packages and 58 CU lines
Built-in library of 31 compatible units plus your own
Material, labour, equipment, overhead and contingency costing
Action factors for install / remove / transfer / abandon
Status workflow with drag and drop
CSV, bill of materials, estimate and summary JSON outputs
